log: Your leader fell. The company cannot continue without them.
Enemy bone archer used bone bow for 3 damage.
Your archer used bow for 1 damage.
Enemy necromancer used grave bolt for 3 damage.
Enemy skeleton used rust blade for 3 damage and took 3 in retaliation.

dialogue.speaker: Warden Sella
dialogue.text: Their bowmen are watching the bridge. My spears can hold the banks, but the skeletons will barely feel their points.

dialogue.speaker: Nera
dialogue.text: Keep the hammer close. Ivo, find a ford. We need those villages earning for us, not for the tollkeeper.

dialogue.speaker: Ivo
dialogue.text: Dry blankets, clean bandages, and six coins. Someone expected the road to open again. I would hate to disappoint them.

dialogue.speaker: The company
dialogue.text: Your leader fell. The company cannot continue without them.

campaign.outcome: Your leader fell. The company cannot continue without them.

dialogue.speaker: Ivo
dialogue.text: The eastern villages have not seen a lantern in three nights. I have their names here. Someone has to read them.

dialogue.speaker: Nera
dialogue.text: Then we get you across. Stay behind the shields. We are not here to win the river; we are here to reach the other bank.

dialogue.speaker: Ivo
dialogue.text: The ford north of the bridge is still open. And the ferryman hid his purse in the old riverside ruin, if we need supplies.
